fact: As of the July 2023 thesis, the PSNP MIS was under an enhancement phase integrating enrolment, targeting, payment, transfer and grievance modules, and the envisioned integrated national social protection information system had never materialized, each programme keeping its own MIS.
title: Architectural Framework for Interoperable Social Protection Information System (SPIS) in Ethiopia: The Case of PSNP and HFA Programs
publisher: Addis Ababa University, School of Information Science
